entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 8 tilt against Jacksonville.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Eric Smith of the Chargers' official site reports.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Tampa Bay, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Tate (shoulder) will not play against the Bengals on Sunday but is expected to be back in action following the Titans' bye for Week 10 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Nov. 15, Paul Kuharsky of PaulKuharsky.com reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday night's game against the Commanders.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Wicks (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Commanders.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Scott Smith of the Bucs' official site reports.

entries.name: Ja'Tavion Sanders
entries.summary: Sanders (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday night's matchup with Green Bay, Darin Gantt of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Jonnu Smith
entries.summary: Smith (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Panthers Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Kaleb Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Panthers, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) was listed as a non-participant for Friday's practice, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: RJ Harvey
entries.summary: Harvey (knee) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, but his injury isn't considered severe or long term, Sam Jane of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Tip Reiman
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur stated he's "not too sure" if Reiman (ankle) will play this season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills designated Shavers (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he will not play against the Ravens on Sunday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle/knee) is questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: Skowronek (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Calvin Ridley
entries.summary: Ridley (hip) is officially questionable for Sunday's matchup against Cincinnati.

entries.name: Cam Skattebo
entries.summary: Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Christian McCaffrey
entries.summary: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Watson said he suffered a broken rib in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (ribs) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Colston Loveland
entries.summary: Loveland was limited at Friday's practice due to a neck injury, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dalton Kincaid
entries.summary: Kincaid (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Lock (elbow) was a limited participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Drew Ogletree
entries.summary: Ogletree (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

entries.name: George Pickens
entries.summary: Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs after he was a limited participant in Friday's practice.

entries.name: John Bates
entries.summary: Bates (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kenny Gainwell
entries.summary: Gainwell (hip) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

entries.name: Luke Schoonmaker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
entries.summary: Zaccheaus (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Rashid Shaheed
entries.summary: Shaheed (knee) didn't practice Friday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

entries.name: Treylon Burks
entries.summary: Burks (foot) is questionable for Sunday night's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) was a limited participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (neck) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hip) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Brashard Smith
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Cole Kmet
entries.summary: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Dameon Pierce
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Pierce (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) remains on track to return in December, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Erick All Jr.
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Jack Bech
entries.summary: Bech (forearm) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Price (chest) was a full participant in Friday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Jalen Brooks
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Brooks (wrist) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) won't return to practice this week, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
